kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستأثر (form X)
# نَسْتَأْثِرُ (nastaʔṯiru) /nas.taʔ.θi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# نَسْتَأْثِرَ (nastaʔṯira) /nas.taʔ.θi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# نَسْتَأْثِرْ (nastaʔṯir) /nas.taʔ.θir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
